All-in-One Manufacturing Solutions

From molten casting to finished machining, we offer specialized processes under one roof. No need for multiple suppliers—we handle everything seamlessly.

Smart Manufacturing Operations

Premium Precision, Competitive Value

Competitive quotes without compromising on casting quality. We optimize tooling to deliver maximum yield while maintaining the highest tolerances.

Comprehensive Metal Casting Capabilities

Turnkey casting and precision engineering solutions engineered to meet all your manufacturing requirements

Patternmaking

Accelerate precision component production with our CAD Patternmaking Solutions. Our engineering team ensures that tooling geometries are not merely accurate but meticulously optimized.

Foundry Casting

Cast solid industrial metal parts with our Foundry Casting services. Our metallurgists employ controlled furnace melting to produce, refine, and deliver defect-free castings.

Precision Machining

Ensure the accuracy and finish of your cast components. Our turning and precision milling processes adhere to stringent drawings, promoting fit and function.

Heat Treatment & Conditioning

Achieve optimal component mechanical strength with our Heat Treatment. From normalizing castings to stress relieving hardened structures.

Surface Finishing

Ensure the refined surface quality of parts with our shot blasting bays. Our technicians are trained to handle finishing operations, prioritizing consistency.

Quality Metrology

Validating and guaranteeing dimensional accuracy. Our quality metrology inspections encompass meticulous verification, from coordinate measuring to physical testing.

Alloy Formulation

Optimize your metal specifications and elevate performance with our Alloy Formulation. Our team ensures strict control of raw melts.

Tooling Maintenance

Enhance manufacturing productivity with our Tooling Maintenance services. From refurbishing patterns to repairing core boxes, contributing to seamless production.

Finished Assembly

Furnish your assembly operations with the readiness they deserve with our Assembly services. We go beyond bare castings to ensure parts fit directly into assemblies.

Chemical Spectrometry & Testing

Certify your metallic microstructure with Anantacast Laboratory Testing. Our analytical methods reliably verify composition and purity.

Design For Casting Optimization

Develop new industrial components with confidence using our Design For Casting Engineers. Our specialists provide guidance in optimizing tooling.

Corrosion Protection

Safeguard machined metal surfaces with our Corrosion Protection treatments. Our specialized coating techniques enhance the durability and working life of manufactured components.
